metadata.title: Groupicorn Georgia IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. Local provider groups are considered before named neighboring catchments. Shortlists are editorial discovery candidates, not rankings. September 22-23, 2026 regional passes added current official or accreditation-backed sites in Athens, Augusta, Columbus, Macon, and Savannah; Metro Atlanta and the remaining regional hubs were not statewide re-verified.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url uses repository-provided provider brand assets where available. Brand assets are discovery references and have not been license-cleared for redistribution.
metadata.geocoding_note: ZIP codes and street addresses are stored; coordinates intentionally left null in this pass. Geocode later with a chosen provider.
metadata.generation_note: Generated from source/areas and source/providers by tools/directory.py; edit canonical source files rather than this artifact.
